title: NoCapsAI GrantFlow
shortDescription: Find funders, draft grant applications, and keep deadlines in view.
fullDescription:
Find the grant. Write it honestly. Make the deadline.

GrantFlow by NoCapsAI helps small nonprofits and small businesses organize grant work in one place.

FIND FUNDERS
Search federal grant opportunities and explore foundation information from public records. Review the original source and eligibility requirements before applying.

DRAFT FROM YOUR OWN FACTS
Build an organization profile and use AI-assisted tools to draft grant application sections. Review highlighted gaps, check every claim, and edit the wording before using a draft.

ORGANIZE THE WORK
Keep application sections, budgets, supporting documents, tasks, and deadlines together. Track progress and follow-up dates across your organization profiles.

EXPORT AND SUBMIT YOURSELF
Export your application as a Word document, then submit it through the funder's official process. You stay in control of what goes out.

KEEP YOUR ACCOUNT
Sign in with your existing GrantFlow account. The Android app uses the same hosted GrantFlow service and requires an internet connection.

Some features may require a Pro subscription. Any subscription price, renewal terms, and available features are shown before purchase. AI-assisted drafts require human review. GrantFlow does not award grants or guarantee funding, and is not affiliated with a government agency.

Support: njwhitt@nocapsai.com
releaseNotes: First Android internal-test candidate for GrantFlow. Uses the existing web service. Validate sign-in, uploads, Word exports, privacy links, AI reports and Google Play subscriptions before production.
